texts.zh: 我们已与[MSI_country.GetName]取得联系。当务之急的事情是，我们必须要小心翼翼地驾驭不断变化的局势。我们应该派遣一名特使来代表我们的利益。无论与我们以前的主人进行任何互动，这肯定会对我们的人民产生深远的心理影响。
texts.en: Contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName]. It's imperative that we navigate the evolving situation carefully. An envoy should be be dispatched to represent our interests. Any interaction with our former masters is sure to have a profound psychological effect on our people.

texts.zh:
在[This.System.GetName]遭遇的外星飞船上得到的数据让我们不寒而栗。它的外观我们再熟悉不过了，上面的徽章宛如我们恐惧的象征：弥那玛特种实业集团的带翼图章。

我们找到了曾经的侵略者。他们发现我们这些舰船的身份只是时间的问题，因为使用的完全都是他们的科技。新的接触不可避免，但我们绝不会重复过去的错误。
texts.en:
Data on the alien vessels we encountered in the [This.System.GetName] was met with a shudder of recognition. Familiar ship designs, marked by an emblem we learned to fear: the winged logo of the Minamar Specialized Industries.

Our former invaders have been found. It's only a matter of time until they realize the ships they sighted are ours, fueled by their own technology. A new contact may be unavoidable, but we can avoid repeating past errors.
